Ta chắc chắn điều đó.

id:

Aku perlu bantuanmu

name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_40504_FUSION
desc:
There are many ways to grow stronger.
It seems that I need your help
in my current state.

raw.en:
There are many ways to grow stronger.
It seems that I need your help
in my current state.
raw.es:
Hay muchas formas de fortalecerse.
Parece que, en mi estado actual,
necesito tu ayuda.
raw.id:
Banyak jalan agar jadi lebih kuat.
Aku perlu bantuanmu
dalam kondisiku saat ini.
raw.pt:
Há muitas formas de ficar mais forte.
Parece que preciso da sua ajuda
no meu estado atual.
raw.th:
มันมีหลายทางที่จะเติบโตแข็งแกร่งขึ้น
ดูเหมือนว่าข้าจะต้องการความช่วยเหลือของเจ้า
ในสภาพแบบนี้ของข้า
raw.vi:
Có rất nhiều cách lớn mạnh hơn.
Dường như ta cần ngươi giúp
ở trạng thái hiện tại của ta.

id:

karena selalu membantuku.
Manusia makhluk hebat.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_40505_FUSION
desc:
I want to thank you sincerely
for always helping me.
Humans are truly splendid creatures.

raw.en:
I want to thank you sincerely
for always helping me.
Humans are truly splendid creatures.
raw.es:
Quiero agradecerte sinceramente
por ayudarme siempre.
Los humanos son espléndidos.
raw.id:
Aku ingin berterima kasih padamu
karena selalu membantuku.
Manusia makhluk hebat.
raw.pt:
Eu queria agradecer sinceramente
por ter me ajudado sempre.
Humanos são criaturas incríveis mesmo.
raw.th:
ข้าอยากจะขอบใจเจ้า
ที่ช่วยเหลือข้ามาเสมอ
มนุษย์เป็นสิ่งมีชีวิตที่ยอดเยี่ยมมาก
raw.vi:
Rất cảm ơn ngươi
đã luôn giúp đỡ ta.
Con người đúng là một sinh vật thật sự tuyệt vời.

id:

desc:

Train with me next time as well.

raw.en:
Well done.
Train with me next time as well.
raw.es:

Entrena conmigo la próxima vez.
raw.id:
Bagus.

raw.pt:
Muito bem.
Treine comigo da próxima também.
raw.th:
ทำได้ดีมาก
ครั้งต่อไปก็มาฝึกกับข้าอีกนะ
raw.vi:
Tốt lắm.
Lần tới, hãy tập luyện với ta.

id:

Dedikasi seperti yang kamu punya langka.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_40524_FUSION
desc:
You have my thanks.
Dedication like yours is rare.

raw.en:
You have my thanks.
Dedication like yours is rare.
raw.es:
Te doy las gracias.
Es raro encontrar una persona tan decidida.
raw.id:
Aku berterima kasih.
Dedikasi seperti yang kamu punya langka.
raw.pt:
Você tem minha gratidão.
Uma dedicação como a sua é rara.
raw.th:
ข้าขอขอบใจเจ้า
ความทุ่มเทในแบบของเจ้านั้นหาได้ยากนั้น
raw.vi:
Ta có lời cảm ơn ngươi.
Sự cống hiến như ngươi quả là hiếm.

id:

desc:

your aid has done for me.

raw.en:
Thanks for everything.
You have no idea of how much
your aid has done for me.
raw.es:
Gracias por todo.
No tienes idea de lo mucho
que me has ayudado.
raw.id:
Terima kasih untuk semuanya.
Kamu tidak tahu
berapa besar bantuanmu padaku.
raw.pt:
Obrigado por tudo.
Você não sabe o quanto
sua ajuda fez por mim.
raw.th:
ขอบใจสำหรับทุกอย่าง
เจ้าไม่รู้หรอกว่าการสนับสนุน
ของเจ้านั้นช่วยข้าได้มากแค่ไหน.
raw.vi:
Cảm ơn vì mọi việc.
Ngươi không biết là
ngươi đã hỗ trợ ta nhiều thế nào đâu.
